summary: RptMnuEmploymentChanges is a component of the HSPnet.UserControls.ReportMenu namespace used for handling employment change reports within a web application. It includes functionality to generate reports in Excel format based on user input, session data, and employment status.
purpose: The purpose of the RptMnuEmploymentChanges control is to facilitate the reporting of employment changes, allowing users to generate detailed reports between specified dates for newly employed, newly resigned, or both categories.

workflows.name: Generate Employment Changes Report
steps: User selects date range using txtStartDate and txtEndDate.
User selects employment status filter using radNewlyEmployed, radNewlyResigned, or radBoth.
User clicks cmdRunExcel button to generate report.
System uses UserSession to determine procedure name and parameters.
System fetches data using stored procedures ReportEmploymentChangesPA or ReportEmploymentChanges.
System outputs report as CSV to lblReportHTML.

business_rules: If UserSession.PlacementCoordinator is true, use ReportEmploymentChangesPA procedure; otherwise, use ReportEmploymentChanges.
conditions: If radNewlyEmployed is checked, set EmployStatus1 to EmployedStart and EmployStatus2 to an empty string.
If radNewlyResigned is checked, set EmployStatus1 to an empty string and EmployStatus2 to Resigned.
If neither is checked, set EmployStatus1 to EmployedStart and EmployStatus2 to Resigned.
system_behavior: The system populates ltlDescription and ltlOptions with report details and notes.
JavaScript setup is handled in SetupJavaScript method during Page_PreRender.
